description: Supervised GitHub Copilot reviews with live events, steering and cancellation.

interface.shortDescription: Supervised, routed GitHub Copilot delegation for Codex and other MCP hosts.
interface.longDescription: Delegate context-only reviews, sparring and proposals through the official Copilot SDK with cross-family model routing; inspect progress, steer or cancel. All delegate tools are denied. Register the MCP server directly (see README).
